correction: EARNINGS_EXPOSURE_ROBUSTNESS_V1 incorrectly capped the dynamic policy at three positions. V2 implements the user's intended staircase: good realised performance increases capacity repeatedly and losses reduce it.
iteration_disclosure: All price periods and the ten-calendar-day earnings proxy were previously inspected. This is adaptive robustness only and has no untouched historical holdout.

frozen_trade_plan.signal: MODEL_0 false-to-true Stage 2 eligibility transition after the close
frozen_trade_plan.entry: next available session open plus 5 bps adverse slippage
frozen_trade_plan.earnings_blackout: Reject signals dated zero through ten calendar days before a retrospective earnings event, inclusive

portfolio.transition_timing: Net allocated realised R across all exits after a session close controls next-session capacity. A positive batch adds 1R up to the variant ceiling. A zero/negative batch either removes 1R or resets to 2R, according to the frozen contraction variant. No exit funds an earlier same-session entry and no existing valid position is forcibly liquidated.

contraction_variants.description: A non-positive exit batch reduces capacity by 1R, not below 2R.
A non-positive exit batch immediately restores the 2R floor.

ranking: Among complete gate passes, rank by lowest worst-stage maximum drawdown, then highest lower-stage expectancy, then lower exposure ceiling, then RESET before STEP, then stable variant id.
decision_rule: A pass may justify prospective forward observation only. It cannot validate or promote the rule because all price periods are reused, the universe is survivorship-biased, and retrospective earnings dates are not point-in-time schedule snapshots.
constraints: Report the fixed-2R baseline and all six staircase variants
Never exceed the frozen 4R, 6R, or 8R safety ceiling
Never let dynamic capacity fall below 2R
Do not alter or relabel V1
Do not change production or the immutable forward journal
